data.name: Accessibility_KeyboardHelp_Content
data.value:
Navigation Ctrl+1–8: Open a workflow Ctrl+L: Open the legacy workspace F1: Open this command reference
Projects and translation Ctrl+O: Open project Ctrl+S: Save project or apply settings F6: Translate selected entry Ctrl+Shift+T: Translate visible scope Esc: Cancel the active operation or discard staged settings
Review and quality Ctrl+Enter: Approve selected entry Ctrl+Shift+Enter: Approve visible scope Ctrl+Z: Undo the last bulk action F8: Go to the selected entry
History and project updates Ctrl+Shift+O: Compare a previous revision Ctrl+Enter: Reuse selected translation Ctrl+Shift+Enter: Reuse visible translations Ctrl+Z: Undo reuse F8: Go to the selected entry
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between controls. Dialogs return focus to the control that opened them.
data.comment: Complete keyboard reference for the preview shell and workflows.
